commentary.text: 90+8' The match has just finished.
90+8' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United).
90+6' Peter Bankes shows a yellow card to Tosin Adarabioyo (Chelsea) for his blatant foul.

90+5' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Chelsea have been awarded a corner kick.

84' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

83' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) with a great individual effort and attempt from long range. The shot went towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper was prepared and managed to keep the ball out. Manchester Utd have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
82' A lofted cross from Reece James (Chelsea) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
81' The current number of shots on goal is 3:1.

79' Reece James (Chelsea) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
78' Peter Bankes blows for a foul after Matthijs de Ligt (Manchester United) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.

68' Tyrique George (Chelsea) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.

63' Reece James (Chelsea) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

61' Manuel Ugarte (Manchester United) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Peter Bankes no option but to blow his whistle.

55' Andrey Santos (Chelsea) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
54' Andrey Santos (Chelsea) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
54' Dangerous play by Harry Maguire (Manchester United). Peter Bankes blows his whistle for a foul.

28' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) commits a rough challenge and Peter Bankes blows his whistle for a foul.

21' Enzo Maresca has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Andrey Santos (Chelsea) replacing Cole Palmer.
20' Joao Pedro (Chelsea) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.

19' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range, but his poor effort sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Chelsea.
17' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Casemiro (Manchester United) was quite harsh and Peter Bankes didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
17' Referee Peter Bankes points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) goes wild in celebration.
15' The Manchester Utd players halt their celebrations as referee Peter Bankes makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
14' 1 - 0 GOAL! A cross into the box is headed down by Patrick Dorgu and Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) does brilliantly to get to the ball and fire home. 1:0.
13' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
12' A pass by Matthijs de Ligt (Manchester United) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball goes out of play and Chelsea will have a goal kick.
11' Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
10' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the corner which is cleared.
9' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
9' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) pounced on a rebound on the edge of the box and his shot goes a whisker over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Chelsea.
8' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) elects to shoot from the edge of the box instead of sending the free kick into the box, but the defensive wall manages to block the shot. Wasted opportunity!
8' Manchester Utd have a free kick.
7' Tosin Adarabioyo (Chelsea) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Pedro Neto.
6' Enzo Maresca is forced to make a tactical change due to a red card. Estêvão (Chelsea) will be replaced by Filip Jorgensen.
5' Robert Sanchez (Chelsea) makes a horror tackle on his opponent and receives a red card from the referee!
3' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) escapes his marker to meet a cross and heads to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off an excellent reflex save to deny him.
